title: Localization of an additive category at a multiplicative system is additive
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that localizing an additive category at a left or right multiplicative system produces an additive category with an additive localization functor (statement lines 2082-2088). The proof is a complete argument: the preceding lemma provides the preadditive structure and the additivity of the localization functor, and the two remaining ingredients of additivity, a zero object and binary direct sums in the localization, are obtained by transporting them from the source category along the additive functor (proof lines 2090-2094). The non-formal content is the observation that additivity of the functor transports the zero object and the direct sums. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
